title: night38: overnight drift in US stock index CFDs (Cliff, Cooper and Gulen 2008; Kelly and Clark 2011; Lou, Polk and Skouras 2019)
before_registration: Only synthetic self-checks (night38.py check) and availability counts (night38.py counts, no return computed) ran on this design. Prior knowledge: imom34 found the overnight return partly reverses in the last half hour of the next session (r_on slope -0.058 [-0.107,-0.009] dev, SPX500); cal37 found no calendar effect in daily index bars (pre-holiday positive but underpowered). No 16:00/09:30 split of SPX500 returns was computed before this registration.
declared: Development evidence only. 2023+ is a development window, not a holdout. Binding confirmation for any survivor is prospective (issue 313) or data after 2026-10-07.
data: history.db candles_ba M1 (read-only), mid = (bid_c + ask_c) / 2, bars with UTC hour 13-20. SPX500/USD, NAS100/USD, US30/USD all present from 2018-01-01 23:00 UTC to 2026-10-09 04:18 UTC. Nothing fetched.
clock: America/New_York, DST per calendar date. P(T) = mid close of the latest M1 bar that starts in [T-3, T-1] min (the bar ending at T, at most 2 minutes stale), else missing.
calendar: Trading days: NYSE weekdays minus full-day holidays (New Year, MLK, Presidents, Good Friday, Memorial, Juneteenth from 2022, July 4, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas with NYSE observance; plus closures 2018-12-05 and 2025-01-09). Cash close 16:00 ET; 13:00 ET on early-close days (day after Thanksgiving, Dec 24 and Jul 3 when they are trading days). Open 09:30 ET.

definitions.night: P(open of the next trading day) / P(close_d) - 1, bps; the row is keyed by the close date d; weekends and holidays span to the next trading open
definitions.skip: a day return needs both points of day d; a night needs close_d and the next open; a missing point drops that return only (no fallback further back)
definitions.span: calendar days from d to the next trading day; weekday night span = 1, weekend/holiday night span > 1
definitions.net_night: night - (median spread at close + median spread at the next open) / 2 (window medians over valid nights, spread = (ask_c - bid_c) / mid of the bar used for P) - 3%/365 x span x 1e4

primary: SPX500/USD all nights: mean night bps, mean day bps, mean night - mean day. Day-block bootstrap validate.day_boot over all trading days in the window (block 5, 1000 reps, seed 38), percentile 95% CI.
decision_rule: PASS iff the night-mean CI lower bound is above 0 in BOTH windows AND the night-minus-day point estimate is above 0 in BOTH windows. Otherwise FAIL. One test, no multiplicity adjustment.
secondary: Never decide the verdict: net night bps and annualized; hit rate; NAS100/USD and US30/USD; weekday vs weekend/holiday nights; nights after an up day vs a down day (sign of day_d); yearly night and day means; MDE80 = 2.8 x bootstrap SD for the night mean and the difference. Long-history check on audit/tsmom36/daily.db is impossible for the 16:00/09:30 split because the daily bars close at 17:00 ET.
